notes: Times are New York local wall-clock time. Sessions are evaluated in code by packages/risk/src/sessionGuard.ts. Update this file each December for the next year and cite the source pages below. After validUntil every session-bound market is treated as closed (fail closed).

us_equity.description: NYSE and Nasdaq regular session. Used for single-stock and US index perps (for example USTECH).

sources.note: 2026 holidays: Jan 1, Jan 19, Feb 16, Apr 3, May 25, Jun 19, Jul 3 (Independence Day observed), Sep 7, Nov 26, Dec 25. Early close 1:00 p.m. on Nov 27 and Dec 24, 2026. No 2026 early close on Jul 2. 2027 holidays: Jan 1, Jan 18, Feb 15, Mar 26, May 31, Jun 18 (observed), Jul 5 (observed), Sep 6, Nov 25, Dec 24 (Christmas observed). Early close 1:00 p.m. on Nov 26, 2027.

fx.description: Spot FX weekly session, Sunday 17:00 to Friday 17:00 New York. Used for EURUSD and other FX perps.

sources.note: Pyth FX feeds publish during the weekly FX session; Injective FX perps use Pyth oracles (live LCD query 2026-11-09 shows oracle_type PythPro for EURUSD/USDC PERP).

cme_globex.description: CME Globex metals and energy (gold, silver, WTI). Sunday to Friday 18:00 to 17:00 New York with a daily 60 minute break.

sources.note: Globex metals and energy: Sunday to Friday 6:00 p.m. to 5:00 p.m. ET with a 60 minute break each day beginning at 5:00 p.m. ET.
CME publishes per-holiday halts. On US holidays where the exact halt time was not confirmed we halt at 13:00 New York, which is earlier than or equal to the CME halt and therefore conservative.

always_open.description: Crypto and compute markets trade 24/7 unless the oracle provider documents otherwise.
